method:
Jabbit analysis for /research/ss-31-elamipretide-mitochondria-aging-teardown.html (run 2026-10-17 ~10:15 AM ET).
Inputs:
  - ClinicalTrials.gov API v2: query.intr and query.term for elamipretide / SS-31 / MTP-131 / Bendavia (merged by NCT ID),
    each record's primary outcome and posted results read; hand-review layer HAND below (primary result per placebo-controlled
    efficacy trial, from the publication, CT.gov results or a trial registry; sources named per row).
  - FDA NDC unfinished-products file + establishment registration file dated Oct 16, 2026 (ops/data/ndc/), substance ELAMIPRETIDE.
  - PubMed E-utilities counts.
Output: site/research/sources/ss31-elamipretide-trials-listings-2026-10-17.json

trials.source: Gibson 2016 Eur Heart J, PMID 26586786: not associated with a significant reduction; CT.gov results
CT.gov posted results: +6.3 vs +12.0 mL/min (placebo higher); Saad 2017 Circ Cardiovasc Interv, PMID 28916603, reports renal blood flow and eGFR gains instead (pilot, 6 vs 8)
Completed Nov 27, 2017; no results posted on CT.gov; no PubMed record found for the NCT number
Completed Jun 2, 2017; no results posted; no PubMed record found for the NCT number
Karaa 2018 Neurology, PMID 29500292: high dose +64.5 vs +20.4 m, P = 0.053; dose trend P = 0.014
Butler 2020 J Card Fail, PMID 32068002: P = 0.90 and 0.28
Karaa 2020 J Cachexia Sarcopenia Muscle, PMID 32096613: +19.8 m, P = 0.0833

trials.condition: Healthy older adults with low muscle ATP
trials.source: Roshanravan 2021 PLoS One, PMID 34264994: delta P = 0.055, percent change P = 0.045; gone by day 7; no effect on fatigue resistance
FDA complete response letter May 15, 2025: P = 0.97 and P = 0.89; label section 14
Karaa 2023 Neurology, PMID 37268435: -3.2 m, P = 0.69; P = 0.37
Ehlers 2024 Ophthalmol Sci, PMID 39605874: did not meet statistical significance on either
Karanjia 2024 Ophthalmology, PMID 37923251: not significantly different at any time point
Dutch trial register results (NL-004124), posted Apr 15, 2026: no more improvement than placebo at week 48
